title: NILS model lifecycle
description: Record 42 (D15): the four states a registered model passes through and the record of each passage, the same in the engine and in Kvasir. A model is registered with its card; admitted by a check that passed, which is kept; promoted, which is refused unless it was admitted, and since record 55 D4 retires nothing, so several admitted or promoted models answer one task and slot; and retired. The site chooses the one model of each task and slot that answers (chosen), by default the one a recorded certificate names. A check that failed is kept too and leaves the state where it was. Every transition is an event with who and when, and an audit row. Nothing is deleted: a retired model still names what it decided. Record 55 ruling 31 (a): a registered card may gain the claims it lacks (the label set it was trained on, its tested claims, its speed), additions only; each addition is an event, claims_added, and an audit row, model.add_claims.

suite.description: What was checked, such as heldout-calibration for a head or Kvasir's admission suite for a served model

passed.description: Whether every check passed; it must agree with checks

failed.description: The names of the checks that failed, as Kvasir records them

equivalence.description: Record 55 A5: the class of the difference between the model's CPU and GPU answers, measured on a fixed set by the admission suite

check.description: A check's result as it is recorded: the one that admitted a model stays on it

class.description: The best class whose bar the two runs meet, read at the card's tolerance; null where a stack's value changed between two answers

changes.description: Answers that changed between a value and not sure

flips.description: Answers that changed from one value to another

top_changed.description: Stacks whose most probable value changed

cpu.description: The CPU run: a run id or a file, and its device

detail.description: The check, the model a promotion retired or was retired by, the review item a person accepted, why; for claims_added (record 55 ruling 31 (a)) the fields it filled, the claims as added, what the card lacked before and after, and why

citation.description: Record 55 ruling 22 (b): the graded run a certificate cites instead of a sample sealed in the registry

manifest_sha256.description: The sha256 of the run's MANIFEST.json

plan_commit.description: The commit that registered the plan before the run was drawn

model_digest.description: The artifact digest of the one model the run graded

equivalence.description: The run that showed the artifact registered here answers as the graded one did

certificate.description: Record 48 R2 and record 55 ruling 22 (b): a recorded certificate, on a sample sealed in the registry or citing the graded run that measured the model, as GET /api/certificates answers it

sample.description: The sealed sample it measured, or evidence:<run> for one that cites its graded run

result.description: On a sealed sample, the result as the certifying tool gave it (sample, sample_digest, risk, n, errors); citing a graded run, bar, n, errors, confidence, bound (the exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson bound the engine worked out from the counts), method and passes, with coverage, test and claim where given

unseals.description: Whether a sample sealed here is unsealed by it; a certificate citing its graded run unseals nothing

words.description: What it certified, in a line

description: A registered model as the engine answers it (GET /api/models/{id}).

encoder_model_id.description: The first encoder a head reads

encoder_model_ids.description: Record 43: every encoder a head reads, in order

threshold.description: Record 43: the card's threshold, at or above which the model's proposals are staged

trained_on_held.description: Added 2026-10-30: where the label set trained_on names is held. here: in this registry, checked against the samples sealed here; training_site: a foreign claim, a set this registry does not hold, kept as the card wrote it and never checked against its rows; null where the card names none

check.description: The check that admitted it, or the last one that failed while it was registered

review_item.description: The review item a person accepted to promote it, when one did

chosen.description: Record 55 D4: whether it is the model chosen for its task and slot now

complete.description: Record 55 D4: whether its card states everything a served model's card does: the label set it was trained on, its tested claims, its speed on CPU and on GPU, its GPU need, its equivalence, its intended use and its limits

missing.description: What its card lacks for that

equivalence_measured.description: The equivalence its admitting check measured

certificate.description: Record 55 ruling 22 (b): the newest recorded certificate naming the model, on a sealed sample or citing its graded run; null where none names it

additions.description: Record 55 ruling 31 (a): the claims its card gained after it was registered, oldest first, read from its claims_added events

fields.description: The fields of missing the claims filled

added.description: The claims as they were added, in the card's own shape: trained_on, tested, speed
